messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired: SEV2 - ap-southeast-1a serving nodes high 5xx rate (>5% sustained 10m). PD link: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-87321|PD-87321>. autotrigger=on, escalation policy=AWS-AZ-availability. auto-divert policy=off (needs manual).

alex.m: taking this. oncall-sre here, pulling metrics and logs now.

samira.k: acked via PD. can you check node cpu + kube OOMs? saw a few OOM kills in az2 earlier that looked related.

alex.m: confirmed higher 5xx coming from model-serving pods on az1a. seeing burst of grpc RST and a spike in kv-cache misses. quick checks:
```
# tail of svc logs (errors only)
2025-11-02T10:01:12Z ERROR grpc: stream error: code = Internal desc = upstream read failure
2025-11-02T10:02:07Z ERROR model-serving: kvcache miss threshold exceeded: 84% miss
2025-11-02T10:03:19Z WARN autoscaler: scale_latency_ms=1200 desired_replicas=12 current_replicas=8
```

infra-bot: metric snapshot: ap-southeast-1a -> 5xx_rate=6.8%, p95_lat=420ms, cpu_avg=78%, avail_nodes=14 (expected 16). Links: <https://grafana.redwood/az/ap-southeast-1a|grafana> <https://logs.redwood/PD-87321|logs>.

ryan.p: curious if this is KV cache eviction cascade. we had a recent kernel update on these hosts yesterday. pinging infra.

maria.s: paging network oncall to verify any NIC flaps. low-level net issues can cause grpc resets and proxy failures.

alex.m: plan — 1) scale up serving group in ap-southeast-1a by +4 replicas, 2) enable routing-diversion to ap-southeast-1b and us-east-1 (gradual), 3) enable kvcache warmup for hot prefixes. doing 1 now.

alex.m: running infractl scale --pool=az1a-serving --add=4 --reason="PD-87321 5xx spike"
infractl: accepted, new desired=12, scaling start ts=1732468935

incident-bot: PD update: PD-87321 acked by alex.m. escalation timers paused.

samira.k: while scaling, let's avoid full divert. can we do weighted divert 25% to us-east-1 first? reduces blast radius.

alex.m: starting weighted divert:
```
routingctl set-weight --from=ap-southeast-1 --to=us-east-1 --weight=25 --policy=gradual
```
routingctl: change accepted, rollout window=5m

infra-bot: autoscaler observed 4 new pods come up in ~90s, readiness=ok for 3/4, one failing readiness due to kv warmup timeout.

alex.m: kicked kv warmup job for top prefixes. also bumped ingress proxy timeouts to 30s for the AZ to reduce premature resets.

ryan.p: network oncall (maria.s) confirmed no NIC flaps at hypervisor level. bump in host kernel errors correlates with increased disk IO on local SSDs, looks like GC from metrics shard. filing infra ticket to investigate deeper.

maria.s: increased diversion to 30% while we watch. monitoring for error rate drop.

incident-bot: PD note: PD-87321 status=Mitigating, summary="weighted divert + scale applied". next update in 10m or on-change.

alex.m: current status: ap-southeast-1a 5xx_rate=3.1% (was 6.8%), p95_lat=380ms. us-east-1 inbound increased as expected, no errors there. starting to roll back diversion if stabilization holds.

samira.k: customer-impact estimate: ~8% of total requests touched ap-southeast-1a during spike window; of those ~10% saw errors — rough impact: ~0.8% overall error increase for hosted API. flagged two enterprise customers (acct-5342, acct-7731) with higher error rates for follow-up.

alex.m: will open a post-incident follow-up for customer outreach and blotter entry. (I'll handoff to night oncall in 40m once system stable).

pagerduty-bot: PD-87321: note added by alex.m: "ap-southeast-1a mitigated by scaling + weighted diversion; infra investigating local SSD IO GC causing proxy resets".

ryan.p: suggested next steps for RCA: collect node-level iostat, kernel logs, and probe kvcache eviction policy interactions with pod restarts. assign infra eng to PD ticket.

maria.s: will stay on until handoff. planning to run a short canary of full traffic for 2m to confirm health, then remove divert entirely.

alex.m: canary done. p95=310ms, 5xx_rate=0.5% now. removing diversion. routingctl set-weight --from=ap-southeast-1 --to=us-east-1 --weight=0

incident-bot: PD update: PD-87321 status=Resolved by mitigation (auto-resolve scheduled if no regression in 20m).

samira.k: adding cleanup checklist: 1) ensure kvcache warmup persisted across restarts, 2) check autoscaler cooldown settings to avoid under-provisioning, 3) schedule infra follow-up for SSD IO GC tuning.

alex.m: handing off to night oncall: @ryan.p will take PD until 2025-11-03 02:00 UTC. leaving notes in PD and ops-runbook.

ryan.p: acked handoff, will monitor. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria.s: closing loop — I'll notify the two affected accounts and include mitigation summary.

incident-bot: thread closed for now. further updates will be appended to PD-87321.
